meta.description: EMUPERSO: NES, SNES, Sega Genesis, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, PlayStation and PlayStation Portable in Chrome, on desktop and phone.
header.subtitle: Retro portal · 10 consoles
header.intro: Play in Chrome on desktop or phone, no app to install and no account. Each console offers a free demo to try right away; your own games stay on your device.
consoles.title: Choose a console
card.nes.desc: FCEUmm engine. Free demo: Snake. Game Genie codes, saves and states.
card.snes.desc: Snes9x engine. Free demos: Neon Breaker, Shmup, SA-1 and DSP-1 chips. Game Genie and Action Replay.
card.nds.desc: DeSmuME engine (or melonDS with your BIOS). Free demo: Pong.
card.genesis.desc: Genesis Plus GX engine. Load a local .md, .smd, .gen or ZIP ROM. Cheats to import; 32X not supported.
card.n64.desc: Mupen64Plus-Next engine. Free EMUPERSO demo. Real games being validated.
card.ps1.desc: PCSX ReARMed engine. Free EMUPERSO demo. Real games being validated.
card.psp.desc: PPSSPP engine. Your .iso, .cso or .pbp games. Per-game CWCheat codes, memory card saves and states. Desktop recommended.
notes.title: Good to know
note.home.title: Your games stay with you
note.home.text: The site can't read your drive: you pick a file or folder yourself. Nothing is sent to a server; the game runs in your browser. No commercial game or BIOS provided.
note.saves.title: Separate saves
note.saves.text: Each game has its own space, identified by its file fingerprint. The browser may wipe this data (cleanup, low space): export your saves regularly.
note.android.title: Android phone
note.android.text: Touch buttons appear under the picture. Sound starts after a first tap. A Bluetooth controller recognized by Chrome works too.
